info.name: Get the runtime audit-event chain for one envelope

items.docs:
Returns the ordered runtime audit-event chain for one evaluation envelope. Events are returned newest-last in SequenceNo ascending order — the same order the runtime appended them. Payloads are returned as recorded; no redaction is applied.

This endpoint does NOT return the submitted request payload; use GET /v1/envelopes/{id} for envelope details (which includes the verbatim submitted JSON under the `submitted.raw` field).

Read-only. Backed by the production envelope and audit repositories. D

info.name: Verify the audit-event chain integrity for one envelope

items.docs:
Runs the per-envelope integrity verifier against the production audit chain for the specified envelope and returns a structured status report. Integrity findings (a broken chain) are reported with HTTP 200 and `valid: false` — a broken chain is the result being reported, not a transport failure. HTTP 500 is reserved for repository / hash-compute errors that prevent verification from completing.

The response does NOT include audit-event payloads, audit-event IDs, the envelope's submitted request

info.name: Export a decision evidence packet for one envelope

items.docs:
Returns a single decision evidence packet composing the existing production reads for one evaluation envelope: the envelope object (same shape as GET /v1/envelopes/{id}), the ordered audit-event chain (same items as GET /v1/evidence/envelopes/{id}/audit-events), and the per-envelope integrity verification result (same shape as GET /v1/evidence/envelopes/{id}/integrity).

info.name: Search runtime audit events across envelopes

params.name: event_type
params.description: Single audit event type. event_types wins when both are supplied.

params.name: event_types
params.description: Comma-separated list of audit event types. Empty tokens are rejected with 400. Whitespace around each token is trimmed. When non-empty, takes precedence over event_type.

params.name: since
params.description: RFC3339 timestamp; inclusive lower bound on event occurred_at.

params.name: until
params.description: RFC3339 timestamp; exclusive upper bound on event occurred_at. Must not be earlier than since.

params.name: limit
params.description: Positive integer in 1..500. Empty applies the audit-list default page size (100). Oversize values are rejected with 400.

params.name: order
params.description: Result ordering by occurred_at. Defaults to desc (newest first).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination token from a prior response's next_cursor (D30j). Pass verbatim — clients must not decode or modify the token. The cursor is bound to the order direction of the originating request; replaying a desc cursor against an asc query is rejected with 400. A malformed token is rejected with 400.

items.docs:
Returns runtime audit events matching the supplied filter, newest-first by default. Backed by the same audit list primitive that powers /v1/coverage and applies the same hard upper bound (default page size 100, maximum 500). Cross-envelope search complements GET /v1/evidence/envelopes/{id}/audit-events (envelope-scoped chain).

Payloads are returned as recorded; no redaction. This endpoint does NOT expose the submitted request payload — use GET /v1/envelopes/{id} for envelope details. payload_co
